review_origin: independent findings supplied in the Chairman redesign directive

findings.finding: Candidate and comparator did not receive identical messages: the candidate payload concatenated the primary and secondary message while the comparator payload received only the primary message. The observed output difference therefore cannot be attributed only to assurance workflow.
findings.required_correction: Hash-bind byte-identical source, brief, messages, attempts, model/tool, timeout and evidence budgets for each pair, with assurance workflow as the sole differing field.

findings.finding: Only three simple synthetic scenarios were used, and their flat generated shapes did not establish genuinely recognizable product-source editing across a credible scenario bank.
findings.required_correction: Freeze at least six visually and semantically recognizable synthetic product sources with explicit recognition features and source hashes.

findings.finding: Rater packages contained no self-contained scoring form for per-option hard gates, anchored quality dimensions, comparative choices, confidence, rationale, elapsed time or protocol-violation reporting.
findings.required_correction: Deliver a complete rater form with four hard gates per option, five dimensions anchored at 1/3/5, A/B/tie/abstain, confidence, rationale, elapsed minutes and protocol violations.

findings.finding: The evidence tree co-located generated candidate/comparator paths, blinded packages and the custody mapping, and the prior manifest exposed those paths. This was not an independently deliverable blinded bundle boundary.
findings.required_correction: Keep custody outside the rater-delivery tree and hash bundles that contain neither identity mapping nor generated-tree paths.

findings.finding: Prior rendered message text was emitted as a single unbounded SVG text element and visibly exceeded the 256-pixel canvas for long scenario text.
findings.required_correction: Enforce fixed canvas, safe-area, text-length and line-fit ceilings, and fail the render on any overflow.

findings.finding: D2 reran existing unit tests and translated a passing test into a treatment signal. It did not mutate a frozen database or repository copy and therefore did not observe a baseline escape or treatment denial.
findings.required_correction: Execute each frozen mutation independently against distinct baseline and treatment copies and record the actual allow or denial mechanism.

findings.finding: No per-fault before snapshot, concrete mutation, rollback, after snapshot, audit/event evidence or noninterference proof was retained.
findings.required_correction: Retain all seven evidence components for baseline and treatment for every fault, and fail if rollback or noninterference does not verify.

findings.finding: The pass decision applied asserted numerical constants to inferred signals instead of deriving treatment requirements from paired baseline observations.
findings.required_correction: Observe baseline escapes and allowed controls first; derive the exact treatment denial and allow sets from those observations without asserted success constants.

findings.finding: The prior D1/D2 execution records and their treatment conclusions depend on invalid comparison designs and cannot support adoption, success, quality, effectiveness or threshold claims.
findings.required_correction: Preserve all prior files unchanged as superseded evidence, explicitly invalidate their treatment conclusions, and require a new independent approval before corrected treatment execution.
